items: 【Patented No-Gap Design】Zupapa's patented No-Gap Design (Patent No. 2022230865778) seamlessly connects the safety net to the jumping mat, eliminating dangerous gaps. This innovative design allows children to safely perform gymnastic stunts like flips and backflips. Plus, the hassle-free assembly saves you 30 minutes on setup by eliminating net-securing ropes.

【High Weight Capacity】Built with premium Q195 steel, Zupapa trampolines feature a robust 51mm diameter frame with a 2.5mm wall thickness, surpassing standard 42mm frames. This ensures exceptional strength, with a static load capacity of 1800LBS and a dynamic load capacity of 450LBS, providing peace of mind for families.

items.label: 【Unbeatable Guarantee】We stand by our product with an industry-leading guarantee
items.value: 10-year frame durability and 2-year coverage on mats, pads, nets, and springs. Plus, enjoy complimentary replacements for any other parts, ensuring worry-free fun for years to come.

items: 【2 Basketball Boards for All Ages】Zupapa's patented basketball hoops (Patent No. 2021218974899) feature metal-free soft baskets and a surrounding net to keep balls contained. With court-like lines, they provide an authentic basketball experience for kids and adults alike.

【Safety is Top Priority】Zupapa Rectangle Trampolines are CPC-certified in the USA and comply with CPSIA and ASTM F381-16 safety standards. Featuring advanced UV protection materials, our trampolines offer a secure and durable backyard entertainment solution for the whole family.

【Enhanced Stability Design】Our rectangular trampoline features a revolutionary four-leg support system, replacing the traditional four-corner design- 𝐈𝐧𝐧𝐨𝐯𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐯𝐞 𝐃𝐞𝐬𝐢𝐠𝐧 - 𝐏𝐚𝐭𝐞𝐧𝐭 𝐏𝐞𝐧𝐝𝐢𝐧𝐠. This innovative structure provides superior middle support and prevents long-side sagging, ensuring unmatched stability and safety for all users.

【Longer Net Poles】Zupapa trampolines prioritize safety with longer net poles that extend to the ground, enhancing net stability. Combined with a densely woven PE enclosure net, this design offers maximum protection, allowing families to bounce with confidence.

items.value: 10 Years for Frame, 2 Years for Jumping Mat & Safety Pad & Enclosure Net & Springs, and free replacement for other parts at any time.
